charts.summary: An anomaly tracker: one thin lane per metric over time, the band it was expected to stay in as a faint fill, the expected value as a hairline, the actual as a line, and every day it stepped outside the band as a flagged dot.

guide.build: One lane per metric over the shared time axis, each on its own scale: the expected band as a faint fill, the expected value as a hairline, the actual as a line, flagged readings as alert dots; lanes sorted by how many were flagged.
bestFor: Watching a dozen daily measures at once and seeing which stepped out of line: net new money, fees, trades, complaints
Operations and risk monitoring, where the exceptions matter more than the levels
avoidFor: Comparing the levels of the measures with each other (each lane has its own scale; use line)
One measure only (use line with a band)

contract.rowMeans: One row per combination of two categories, such as month and product.

charts.summary: Stage swimlanes: one row per item on a shared date axis, each stage drawn from its date to the next in a deepening tint of one hue, a tick at every stage date, and the last reached stage running on faintly while its next date is unknown.

guide.build: One row per data row on a shared date axis: from each stage's date to the next a segment in a deepening tint, a tick at every date, a faint run from the last known stage to the edge when the next date is missing, a today line, and a status pill at the end; impact sets the row's thickness.
bestFor: Where each regulation stands: proposed, adopted, in force, applies
What applies next, and how long since adoption
Any multi-stage process with dates per stage: deals, hiring, product launches
avoidFor: One start and one end per row (use timeline)

More than about 30 rows (filter, or facet by group)
